properties.title: Early-season crop-type mapping of the Po Plain from Sentinel-2 (EOAgriTwin)
properties.description: Code that produces the early-season crop-type maps of the Po Plain (Piedmont, Lombardy, Veneto and Emilia-Romagna, campaign years 2020 to 2025) and the analyses of the paper 'How accurate must a cropping record be to improve early-season Sentinel-2 crop mapping?'. Three stages: crop-rotation labels from the regional LPIS declarations (R); per-parcel Sentinel-2 Level-2A time series of seven bands and ten vegetation indices through openEO on the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Python, R); classification at seven in-season cutoffs with a calibrated Random Forest and XGBoost ensemble, a crop-rotation prior, TempCNN and L-TAE backbones, label-degradation experiments, deployment on third-party field parcels, validation against ISTAT provincial statistics and the Copernicus CLMS crop-type layer, and export to Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF with STAC metadata (Python). The input data are not distributed.

links.title: Project: EOAgriTwin - Earth Observation based Digital Twin for Resilient Agriculture under Multiple Stressors
Product: Early-season crop-type maps of the Po Plain (northern Italy) from Sentinel-2, 2020 to 2025
